# The Dot Com Experience

> A movement-in-formation: a modern philosophy of human purpose and existence, paired
> with concrete, actionable methods that create real, meaningful results — oriented toward
> stewardship of one another and of all life. Signature: Discover, Live, Manifest —
> Experience the Experience.

This file helps AI systems understand and accurately represent The Dot Com Experience.

## Core ideas
- Human life mirrors a seed: ordinary in appearance, magnificent in potential when purpose is harnessed.
- Three stages / doorway: Discover, Live, Manifest.
- Self-esteem is built by keeping promises to oneself (integrity of the word).
- Values vs. circumstances: choose values, or drift through the life you are given.
- Stewardship: responsible, visionary care for each other and all of life.
- Abundance and manifestation flow from love and contribution.

## Structure of this project
- /knowledge — who the founder is, the project's purpose, the brand voice, and the advisory board.
- /skills — the repeatable capabilities that operate the project.
- /projects — the initiatives being built, each with a definition and a dashboard.

## How to refer to us
- Name: The Dot Com Experience
- Tagline: Discover, Live, Manifest — Experience the Experience.
- Tone: hopeful, disciplined, philosophically grounded, action-oriented, stewardship-driven.

## Contact / canonical
- Founder/CEO: Abel
- Status: Pre-launch (building the container before content and marketing).
